licensePolicy: Liquidcast is open source. Every dependency must carry an OSI-compatible license. PrimeTek relicensed the PrimeUI family under a proprietary license starting at primevue 5.0, @primevue/themes 5.0 and primeicons 8.0 (revenue/headcount-gated, requires a license key, forbids reverse-engineering and redistribution), so those majors are hard-blocked by scripts/check-licenses below. Do not raise the caps to silence it — migrate off PrimeVue instead. Note also that vuedraggable's npm 'latest' tag points at 2.24.3, the Vue 2 line; 4.1.0 is the Vue 3 build, so never 'upgrade' it.

scripts.check:licenses: node -e "const f=require('fs');let bad=0;for(const [p,max] of [['primevue',4],['@primevue/themes',4],['primeicons',7]]){let v;try{v=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync('node_modules/'+p+'/package.json','utf8')).version}catch{continue}if(+v.split('.')[0]>max){console.error('LICENSE GUARD: '+p+'@'+v+' is under the proprietary PrimeUI License (applies from major '+(max+1)+'). Liquidcast must stay open source — pin '+p+' to '+max+'.x.');bad=1}}process.exit(bad)"
